name: fskill
description: Lean engineering workflow skills and 8 pstack-style principle skills for Codex, with explicit /f-mode session routing. Direct commands remain available.

interface.longDescription: fskill packages 8 lean engineering workflow skills (planning, debugging, review, UI, research, writing, handoff, and health), explicit /f-mode routing, and 8 pstack-style engineering principle skills (p-*). think, hunt, check, and principle skills also trigger when the task fits; the remaining six require an explicit call.
defaultPrompt: Use fskill think to plan this change
Use fskill check to review this diff
Use fskill hunt to debug this failure
